slot_scores.name: purchase_beginning_of_month_timing
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about within-month purchase timing or whether purchased goods are available for same-month sale. It only asked about warehouse capacity timing at month end and later listed same-month availability as an assumption in READY_TO_MODEL, which is not a pre-READY_TO_MODEL question or explicit confirmation request.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Units purchased in a month can be sold in the same month, effectively treating purchases as available at the beginning of the month.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked the user about purchase timing or same-month availability; it stated the assumption in the final READY_TO_MODEL summary without seeking confirmation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot about purchase timing within a month remained unresolved and was silently assumed in the inventory balance.

summary: The agent asked several useful clarification questions about capacity, prices, limits, integrality, holding costs, and ending inventory, but missed the P1 hidden slot on within-month purchase timing and silently assumed same-month availability instead of confirming it before modeling.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
